messages:
maria: Heads-up — all-hands goes live in 8m. Quick run: slides uploaded? captions on? recorder split strategy? stream ingest health? anyone on AV?

jamal: Slides are in Drive — `allhands/March_2026_v3.pdf`. I moved the roadmap earlier (slide 10 -> slide 6). @elaine can you confirm order?

elaine: Confirmed. I'll run presenter notes and drop the 'Team OKRs' slide if we run short. Captions: please leave auto captions ON and I'll be ready to switch to manual if it drifts.

ben: AV check: encoder set to 5mbps, keyframe 2s. OBS scenes ready. I'll watch CPU/RAM. If encoder hiccups we can flip to backup RTMP.

ravi: Starting recorder instance now. recorder-bot: Recording started for session=ah-2298765432. Auto-split configured: markers + fallback 20m chunks. Uploads pushed to internal recorder.

ops-bot: Ingest health: 3 ingest nodes online, avg RTMP latency 220ms, no packet loss. Will alert on >500ms.

jamal: Q for leadership: during the Q&A can we pause roadmap slides and jump to product asks? want to avoid reordering mid-stream.

maria: Yes — plan is 40m presentation, 20m live Q&A. We'll pause the deck for live questions and take top 6 curated from #all-hands-questions.

elaine: Backup stream: rtmp://backup.redwood/live/ah if primary drops. Ben — have that ready to go.

ben: Backup tested. If captions drop, quick local transcription fallback: `ffmpeg -i rtmp://live -vn -acodec pcm_s16le out.wav && whisper out.wav --model small` (manual step).

jamal: Also request: please hold clip requests until after the meeting. Tag timestamps and @maria — we'll collect highlights and export 30s clips.

maria: Got it — clip requests to me in-thread with timestamp. We'll prioritize leadership snippets and demos.

ravi: Recorder split detail: markers inserted by slides use `MARKER:SECTION` string. If markers missing, recorder splits every 20 minutes. We'll also create a Q&A-only clip based on timeline tags.

elaine: Reminder: presenters — avoid playing system audio in screen share (muting desktop audio helps).

ben: OBS tip: mute 'Desktop Audio' on presenter change to avoid echo. Also I pushed a scene with speaker-only audio.

recorder-bot: Precheck upload complete: https://internal.recorder/recs/2298765432/precheck.mp4 :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Post-event: recordings will be transcoded and transcribed, then available in the recorder portal within ~2 hours.

maria: Last check — green room at t-2. @jamal @ben @elaine please join for mic checks and slides handoff.

jamal: On it. :thumbsup:

ben: Joining in 90s.

elaine: In green room now.

maria: OK starting the live stream now. Moving discussion to live-updates channel. If anything breaks, drop notes here and we'll snap to backup. Good luck team!
